anomalies.message: CPU load average is significantly high across all time intervals (1, 5, and 15 minutes), indicating potential CPU bottleneck or excessive processing load.
AI system has not generated any learning cycles, opportunities, or adjustments, suggesting it may not be functioning or is underutilized.
Trading metrics show zero active trades, total profit/loss, win rate, and ROI, indicating no trading activity despite active strategies.

optimizations.recommendation: Investigate and optimize CPU usage by analyzing running processes and possibly upgrading hardware or optimizing software.
Review and potentially reconfigure AI models and trading strategies to ensure they are functioning correctly and generating opportunities.

recommendations.action: Conduct an immediate review of system processes to identify and mitigate causes of high CPU load.
recommendations.rationale: High CPU load can lead to system instability and degraded performance, affecting trading operations.

recommendations.action: Verify the operational status of AI components and trading algorithms to ensure they are active and correctly configured.
recommendations.rationale: AI inactivity and lack of trading activity can result in missed trading opportunities and financial losses.

recommendations.action: Perform a comprehensive audit of system configurations and logs to identify any misconfigurations or errors.
recommendations.rationale: Ensuring correct configurations and error-free operation is essential for optimal system performance.
